```{r enrichment_functions}
cached_gsea <- function(geneList, database = "GO", ...) {
    paths <- if (database == "GO") 
        c(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "CM_GSEA_GO_mPAP.rds"), file.path(checkpoint_dir, "GSEA_all_nonCM_list.rds"))
    else file.path(checkpoint_dir, "CM_GSEA_KEGG_mPAP.rds")
    for (path in paths[file.exists(paths)]) {
        objects <- readRDS(path)
        if (methods::is(objects, "gseaResult")) 
            objects <- list(objects)
        for (object in objects) if (isTRUE(all.equal(geneList, object@geneList, tolerance = 1e-12))) 
            return(object)
    }
    if (database == "GO") 
        gseGO(geneList = geneList, ...)
    else gseKEGG(geneList = geneList, ...)
}
emapplot <- function(...) {
    p <- enrichplot::emapplot(...)
    expand_range <- function(r) {
        d <- diff(r)
        if (d < 1e-08) 
            d <- max(abs(r), 1)
        r + c(-1, 1) * d * 0.15
    }
    p + coord_cartesian(xlim = expand_range(range(p$data$x)), ylim = expand_range(range(p$data$y)), clip = "off") + 
        theme(aspect.ratio = NULL)
}
```

## read CM

```{r read_CM, eval=TRUE}
DCM_RV <- qs2::qs_read(here::here("data", "processed", "RV_cell_states_RNA.qs2"), nthreads = 2)
DCM_RV <- subset(DCM_RV, Group == "DCM")
CM <- qs2::qs_read(here::here("data", "processed", "CM", "annotated.qs2"), nthreads = 2)
CM <- subset(CM, Group == "DCM")
DefaultAssay(CM) <- "RNA"
Idents(CM) <- "cell_state"
```

## update clinical metadata

```{r update_clinical_metadata, eval=TRUE}
Clinical_data <- read_excel(here::here("data", "DCM_Clinical_data_22.xlsx"))
add_metadata <- DCM_RV[[]] %>% dplyr::select(Sample) %>% left_join(Clinical_data, by = "Sample")
row.names(add_metadata) <- row.names(DCM_RV[[]])
cols_to_overwrite <- setdiff(colnames(Clinical_data), "Sample")
DCM_RV@meta.data[, cols_to_overwrite] <- NULL
DCM_RV <- AddMetaData(DCM_RV, metadata = add_metadata)
add_metadata_CM <- CM[[]] %>% dplyr::select(Sample) %>% left_join(Clinical_data, by = "Sample")
row.names(add_metadata_CM) <- row.names(CM[[]])
CM@meta.data[, cols_to_overwrite] <- NULL
CM <- AddMetaData(CM, metadata = add_metadata_CM)
rm(add_metadata, add_metadata_CM, Clinical_data, cols_to_overwrite)
```

## metadata

```{r metadata}
metadata <- CM@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Batch_processing, Batch_sequencing, Age_years, Sex, Group, mPAP_mmHg, 
    sPAP_mmHg, PCW_mmHg, PVR_WU, TAPSE_mm, RVIT_mm, LVEF_percent, LVEDD_mm) %>% unique() %>% dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, 
    names(table(CM$Sample))))
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample
all.equal(metadata$Sample, names(table(CM$Sample)))
reactable(metadata, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
metadata_DCM <- metadata %>% dplyr::filter(Group == "DCM")
stopifnot(all(metadata_DCM$Group == "DCM"), !anyDuplicated(metadata_DCM$Sample))
write.csv(metadata_DCM, file.path(output_dir_data, "A_clinical_donor_metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Speckle all

```{r Speckle_all}
differential_abundance <- data.frame()
props <- getTransformedProps(CM$cell_state, CM$Sample, transform = "logit")
for (i in 7:(length(metadata_DCM))) {
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM[complete.cases(metadata_DCM[[i]], metadata_DCM$Age_years), ]
    props_subset <- props
    props_subset$Counts <- props$Counts[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    props_subset$TransformedProps <- props$TransformedProps[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    props_subset$Proportions <- props$Proportions[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    metadata_subset <- metadata_subset %>% arrange(Sample, colnames(props_subset$Proportions))
    design <- model.matrix(~metadata_subset[[i]] + metadata_subset[["Age_years"]])
    fit <- lmFit(props_subset$TransformedProps, design)
    fit <- eBayes(fit, robust = TRUE)
    differential_abundance_temp <- topTable(fit, n = Inf, coef = 2)
    differential_abundance_temp$metadata <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    differential_abundance_temp$cell_state <- rownames(differential_abundance_temp)
    differential_abundance <- rbind(differential_abundance, differential_abundance_temp)
}
rm(metadata_subset, props_subset, design, fit, differential_abundance_temp)
rownames(differential_abundance) <- NULL
differential_abundance <- dplyr::arrange(differential_abundance, adj.P.Val)
write.csv(differential_abundance, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "CM_Differential_Abundance.csv"), row.names = F)
reactable(differential_abundance, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

## Speckle LVEDD mm

```{r Speckle_LVEDD_mm, fig.height=4, fig.width=20}
metadata_subset <- metadata[complete.cases(metadata[["LVEDD_mm"]]), ]
props_subset <- props
props_subset$Counts <- props$Counts[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
props_subset$TransformedProps <- props$TransformedProps[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
props_subset$Proportions <- props$Proportions[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
metadata_subset <- metadata_subset %>% arrange(Sample, colnames(props_subset$Proportions))
design <- model.matrix(~metadata_subset$LVEDD_mm + metadata_subset$Age_years)
fit.prop <- lmFit(props_subset$Proportions, design)
par(mfrow = c(1, 5), mar = c(5, 5, 3, 1))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(props_subset$Proportions))) {
    plot(metadata_subset$LVEDD_mm, props_subset$Proportions[i, ], main = rownames(props_subset$Proportions)[i], 
        pch = 16, cex = 2, ylab = "Proportions", xlab = "LVEDD_mm", cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2.5)
    abline(a = fit.prop$coefficients[i, 1], b = fit.prop$coefficients[i, 2], col = 4, lwd = 1)
}
rm(metadata_subset, props_subset, design, fit.prop)
```

## load CM DE results

```{r load_CM_DE_results}
parameters <- c("mPAP_mmHg", "sPAP_mmHg", "PCW_mmHg", "PVR_WU", "TAPSE_mm", "RVIT_mm", "LVEF_percent", "LVEDD_mm")
tested_param <- c("mPAP (mmHg)", "sPAP (mmHg)", "PCWP (mmHg)", "PVR (WU)", "TAPSE (mm)", "RVIT (mm)", "LVEF (%)", 
    "LVEDD (mm)")
results <- list()
signif <- list()
volcano <- list()
n_de_genes <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_along(parameters)) {
    results[[i]] <- read.csv(here::here("output", "Clinical_transcriptomic_associations", paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Results_", 
        parameters[i], ".csv")))
    signif[[i]] <- read.csv(here::here("output", "Clinical_transcriptomic_associations", paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Significant_", 
        parameters[i], ".csv")))
    names(results)[i] <- parameters[i]
    names(signif)[i] <- parameters[i]
    design <- read.csv(here::here("output", "Clinical_transcriptomic_associations", paste0("A_Cardiomyocytes_design_", 
        parameters[i], ".csv")), row.names = 1)
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM[match(rownames(design), metadata_DCM$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
    n_de_genes_temp <- data.frame(metadata = parameters[i], n_upregulated = sum(signif[[i]]$logFC > 0.5), n_downregulated = sum(signif[[i]]$logFC < 
        -0.5), n_tot = nrow(signif[[i]]))
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, n_de_genes_temp)
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results[[i]]))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results[[i]]))
    keyvals[results[[i]]$logFC > 0.5 & results[[i]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[results[[i]]$logFC < -0.5 & results[[i]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    volcano[[i]] <- EnhancedVolcano(results[[i]], lab = results[[i]]$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", ylab = bquote(~-Log[10] ~ 
        italic(FDR)), labSize = 0, titleLabSize = 16, subtitleLabSize = 0, axisLabSize = 12, captionLabSize = 0, 
        pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3), colCustom = keyvals, colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, 
        subtitle = NULL, title = paste0("Cardiomyocytes", "\n", tested_param[i], "\nn = ", nrow(metadata_subset))) + 
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    names(volcano)[i] <- parameters[i]
}
rm(metadata_subset, n_de_genes_temp, keyvals)
```

## UpSet plot DE up

```{r UpSet_plot_DE_up, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
gene_sets <- list()
for (i in 1:length(signif)) {
    gene_sets[[i]] <- dplyr::filter(signif[[i]], logFC > 0)$gene
    names(gene_sets)[i] <- tested_param[i]
}
m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets, mode = "intersect", min_set_size = 10)
m <- m[comb_degree(m) >= 2]
m <- m[comb_size(m) >= 1]
UpSet(m, column_title = "Cardiomyocytes - Upregulated genes", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, 
    add_numbers = TRUE), right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))
```

## ENTREZID

```{r ENTREZID}
up_genes <- filter(signif[["mPAP_mmHg"]], logFC > 0.5)$gene
up_genes <- bitr(up_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")$ENTREZID
down_genes <- filter(signif[["mPAP_mmHg"]], logFC < -0.5)$gene
down_genes <- bitr(down_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")$ENTREZID
```

## reorder GO by pvalue

```{r reorder_GO_by_pvalue}
reorder_GO_by_pvalue <- function(enrichGO_result) {
    go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
    go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(go_results$p.adjust), ]
    enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
    return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

```{r save_ORA_GO_mPAP, eval=TRUE}
mPAP_GO_up <- if (file.exists(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "CM_ORA_GO_mPAP_up.rds"))) readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, 
    "CM_ORA_GO_mPAP_up.rds")) else enrichGO(up_genes, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", universe = universe_entrez, ont = "ALL", 
    readable = TRUE)

mPAP_GO_up <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(mPAP_GO_up)

mPAP_GO_down <- if (file.exists(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "CM_ORA_GO_mPAP_down.rds"))) readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, 
    "CM_ORA_GO_mPAP_down.rds")) else enrichGO(down_genes, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", universe = universe_entrez, ont = "ALL",
```

```{r ranked_genes}
results_mPAP <- results[["mPAP_mmHg"]]
results_mPAP$metric <- results_mPAP$logFC * -log10(results_mPAP$PValue)
entrezid <- bitr(results_mPAP$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", drop = TRUE)
results_mPAP <- merge(results_mPAP, entrezid, by.x = "gene", by.y = "SYMBOL", all.x = TRUE)
results_mPAP[duplicated(results_mPAP$metric) | duplicated(results_mPAP$metric, fromLast = TRUE), ]
results_mPAP <- results_mPAP[!duplicated(results_mPAP$metric), ]
write.csv(results_mPAP, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "CM_results_mPAP.csv"), row.names = F)
reactable(results_mPAP, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
ranked_genes <- results_mPAP[!is.na(results_mPAP$ENTREZID), ]
genelist <- ranked_genes$metric
names(genelist) <- ranked_genes$ENTREZID
genelist <- genelist[order(genelist, decreasing = T)]
```

```{r classify_terms}
classify_terms <- function(df) {
    df$sign <- ifelse(df$NES > 0, "activated", "suppressed")
    return(df)
}
```

```{r GSEA_GO_emapplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}

activated_terms <- subset(GSEA_GO@result, sign == "activated")
suppressed_terms <- subset(GSEA_GO@result, sign == "suppressed")

    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, family = "Arial"))
p2 <- emapplot(GSEA_GO_suppressed, showCategory = 100, node_label_size = 3.5, min_edge = 0.2) + ggtitle("Suppressed Terms") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, family = "Arial"))
A_fix_network_coords <- function(p) {
    A_expand <- function(r) {
        d <- diff(r)
        if (d < 1e-08) 
            d <- max(abs(r), 1)
        r + c(-1, 1) * d * 0.15
    }
    p + coord_cartesian(xlim = A_expand(range(p$data$x)), ylim = A_expand(range(p$data$y)), clip = "off") + theme(aspect.ratio = NULL)
}
p1 <- A_fix_network_coords(p1)
p2 <- A_fix_network_coords(p2)
combined_plot <- p1 | p2
print(combined_plot)
```

## reorder GO by NES

```{r reorder_GO_by_NES}
reorder_GO_by_NES <- function(enrichGO_result) {
    go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
    go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(dplyr::desc(go_results$NES)), ]
    enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
    return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

## default labeller

```{r default_labeller}
default_labeller <- function(n) {
    function(str) {
        str <- gsub("_", " ", str)
        ep_str_wrap(str, n)
    }
}
```

## barplot.enrichResult

```{r barplot_enrichResult}
barplot.enrichResult <- function(height, x = "Count", color = "p.adjust", showCategory = 8, font.size = 12, title = "", 
    label_format = 30, ...) {
    object <- height
    colorBy <- match.arg(color, c("pvalue", "p.adjust", "qvalue"))
    if (x == "geneRatio" || x == "GeneRatio") {
        x <- "GeneRatio"
    }
    else if (x == "count" || x == "Count") {
        x <- "Count"
    }
    df <- fortify(object, showCategory = showCategory, by = x, ...)
    if (colorBy %in% colnames(df)) {
        p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x, y = "Description", fill = colorBy)) + theme_dose(font.size) + set_enrichplot_color(type = "fill", 
            name = color)
    }
    else {
        p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x, y = "Description", fill = "Description")) + theme_dose(font.size) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    }
    label_func <- default_labeller(label_format)
    if (is.function(label_format)) {
        label_func <- label_format
    }
    p + geom_col() + scale_y_discrete(labels = label_func) + ggtitle(title) + ylab(NULL)
}
```

## ep str wrap

```{r ep_str_wrap}
ep_str_wrap <- function(string, width) {
    x <- gregexpr(" ", string)
    vapply(seq_along(x), FUN = function(i) {
        y <- x[[i]]
        n <- nchar(string[i])
        len <- (c(y, n) - c(0, y))
        idx <- len > width
        j <- which(!idx)
        if (length(j) && max(j) == length(len)) {
            j <- j[-length(j)]
        }
        if (length(j)) {
            idx[j] <- len[j] + len[j + 1] > width
        }
        idx <- idx[-length(idx)]
        start <- c(1, y[idx] + 1)
        end <- c(y[idx] - 1, n)
        words <- substring(string[i], start, end)
        paste0(words, collapse = "\n")
    }, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
}
```

```{r programme_models}
fixed <- read.csv(here::here("data", "processed", "resources", "A_submitted_918_programme_memberships.csv"))
derived <- read.csv(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "A_fresh_GSEA_derived_programme_memberships.csv"))
definitions <- list(Fixed = fixed, GSEA_derived = derived)
programme_scores <- list()
programme_statistics <- list()
programme_plots <- list()
for (definition in names(definitions)) {
    membership <- definitions[[definition]]
    for (programme in unique(membership$Program)) {
        genes <- intersect(membership$gene[membership$Program == programme], rownames(counts_mPAP))
        expression <- counts_mPAP[genes, , drop = FALSE]
        standardized <- t(scale(t(expression)))
        standardized[is.nan(standardized)] <- 0
        d <- data.frame(Sample = colnames(expression), Score = colMeans(standardized), mPAP = metadata_mPAP$mPAP_mmHg, 
            Age_years = metadata_mPAP$Age_years, Program = programme, Definition = definition)
        fit <- lm(Score ~ mPAP, data = d)
        age_fit <- lm(Score ~ mPAP + Age_years, data = d)
        unadjusted <- summary(fit)
        adjusted <- summary(age_fit)
        key <- paste(definition, programme)
        programme_scores[[key]] <- d
        programme_statistics[[key]] <- data.frame(Definition = definition, Program = programme, n = nrow(d), available_genes = length(genes), 
            beta = unadjusted$coefficients["mPAP", 1], PValue = unadjusted$coefficients["mPAP", 4], R_squared = unadjusted$r.squared, 
            age_adjusted_beta = adjusted$coefficients["mPAP", 1], age_adjusted_PValue = adjusted$coefficients["mPAP", 
                4])
        programme_plots[[definition]][[programme]] <- ggplot(d, aes(mPAP, Score)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
            se = TRUE, colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.4) + theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") + labs(title = paste(stringr::str_wrap(programme, 
            20), "\nR² =", round(unadjusted$r.squared, 3), "p =", round(unadjusted$coefficients["mPAP", 4], 5)), 
            x = "mPAP (mmHg)", y = "Gene Set Score")
    }
}
programme_scores <- bind_rows(programme_scores)
programme_statistics <- bind_rows(programme_statistics) %>% group_by(Definition) %>% mutate(FDR_five_programmes = p.adjust(PValue, 
    "BH"), age_adjusted_FDR_five_programmes = p.adjust(age_adjusted_PValue, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
saveRDS(list(Within_DCM_programme_scores = programme_scores, Within_DCM_programme_statistics = programme_statistics, 
    Derived_programme_memberships = derived), file.path(output_dir_data, "Programme_results_for_EV5.rds"))
```

## mPAP TF barplot

```{r mPAP_TF_barplot, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
n_tfs <- 40
f_contrast_acts <- contrast_acts %>% mutate(rnk = NA)
msk <- f_contrast_acts$score > 0
f_contrast_acts[msk, "rnk"] <- rank(-f_contrast_acts[msk, "score"])
f_contrast_acts[!msk, "rnk"] <- rank(-abs(f_contrast_acts[!msk, "score"]))
tfs <- f_contrast_acts %>% arrange(rnk) %>% head(n_tfs) %>% pull(source)
f_contrast_acts <- f_contrast_acts %>% filter(source %in% tfs)
ggplot(f_contrast_acts, aes(x = reorder(source, score), y = score)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = score), stat = "identity") + 
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "darkblue", high = "indianred", mid = "whitesmoke", midpoint = 0) + theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
```

```{r activity_function}
activity_scores <- function(object, assay, network, method, minsize = 10, weight = "mor") {
    checkpoint <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, "CM_activities.qs2")
    if (file.exists(checkpoint)) {
        previous <- qs2::qs_read(checkpoint, nthreads = 2)
        same <- setequal(colnames(object), colnames(previous)) && identical(rownames(object[["RNA"]]), rownames(previous[["RNA"]]))
        if (same) 
            same <- isTRUE(all.equal(GetAssayData(object, assay = "RNA", slot = "data"), GetAssayData(previous, 
                assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[, colnames(object), drop = FALSE], tolerance = 0))
        if (same && assay %in% names(previous@assays)) 
            return(subset(previous[[assay]], cells = colnames(object)))
    }
    expression <- GetAssayData(object, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
    batches <- split(seq_len(ncol(expression)), ceiling(seq_len(ncol(expression))/1000))
    fit <- get(paste0("run_", method), asNamespace("decoupleR"))
    scores <- bind_rows(lapply(batches, function(cells) fit(mat = as.matrix(expression[, cells, drop = FALSE]), 
        network = network, .source = "source", .target = "target", .mor = weight, minsize = minsize, center = FALSE, 
        sparse = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)))
    scores <- scores %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = source, names_from = condition, values_from = score) %>% column_to_rownames("source")
    object[[assay]] <- CreateAssayObject(scores)
    DefaultAssay(object) <- assay
    object <- ScaleData(object)
    object[[assay]]@data <- object[[assay]]@scale.data
    object[[assay]]
}
```

## Pathway barplot

```{r Pathway_barplot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
ggplot(contrast_acts, aes(x = reorder(source, score), y = score)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = score), stat = "identity") + 
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = Pathway_cols) + theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") + theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
    size = 18, family = "Arial"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 15, face = "plain", 
    colour = "black", family = "Arial"), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "plain", colour = "black", 
    family = "Arial"), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + xlab("Pathway")
```

## Pathway TGFb

```{r Pathway_TGFb, fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
pathway <- "TGFb"
df <- net_path %>% filter(source == pathway) %>% arrange(target) %>% mutate(ID = target, color = "3") %>% column_to_rownames("target")
inter <- sort(intersect(rownames(ranked_genes_TF), rownames(df)))
df <- df[inter, ]
df["metric"] <- ranked_genes_TF[, "metric", drop = FALSE][inter, ]
df <- df %>% mutate(color = if_else(weight > 0 & metric > 0, "1", color)) %>% mutate(color = if_else(weight > 0 & 
    metric < 0, "2", color)) %>% mutate(color = if_else(weight < 0 & metric > 0, "2", color)) %>% mutate(color = if_else(weight < 
    0 & metric < 0, "1", color))
ggplot(df, aes(x = weight, y = metric, color = color)) + geom_point(size = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("#A63A2A", 
    "#004C8C", "white")) + geom_label_repel(aes(label = ID), size = 2.5, family = "Arial") + theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "dotted") + ggtitle(pathway)
```

## Pathway heatmap Sample

```{r Pathway_heatmap_Sample, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
sample_acts <- run_ulm(mat = counts_mPAP, net = net_path, .source = "source", .target = "target", .mor = "weight", 
    minsize = 5)
sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "condition", names_from = "source", values_from = "score") %>% 
    column_to_rownames("condition") %>% as.matrix()
sample_acts_mat <- scale(sample_acts_mat)
sample_acts_mat <- t(sample_acts_mat)
sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts_mat[, metadata_heatmap$Sample, drop = FALSE]
my_breaks <- c(seq(-3, 0, length.out = ceiling(101/2) + 1), seq(0.05, 3, length.out = floor(101/2)))
ordered_sources <- contrast_acts %>% arrange(dplyr::desc(score)) %>% pull(source)
sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts_mat[ordered_sources, , drop = FALSE]
pheatmap::pheatmap(name = " ", angle_col = "45", sample_acts_mat, breaks = my_breaks, color = Pathway_cols, cluster_rows = FALSE, 
    cluster_cols = FALSE, annotation_col = ann_col, annotation_colors = ann_colors, show_colnames = TRUE, annotation_legend = TRUE, 
    border_color = NA, fontsize = 16, fontsize_row = 16, fontsize_col = 12, cellheight = 15, cellwidth = 15, gaps_col = c(0, 
        0, 0, 0), gaps_row = c(3, 3))
```

## Pathway heatmap cluster

```{r Pathway_heatmap_cluster, fig.width=6, fig.height=2.5}
df_pathway <- t(as.matrix(CM@assays$pathwaysmlm@data)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::mutate(cluster = Seurat::Idents(CM)) %>% 
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>% dplyr::group_by(cluster, 
    source) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(score))
top_acts_mat <- df_pathway %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = "cluster", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>% 
    tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "cluster") %>% as.matrix()
my_breaks <- c(seq(-1.25, 0, length.out = ceiling(101/2) + 1), seq(0.05, 1.25, length.out = floor(101/2)))
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = top_acts_mat, color = Pathway_cols, border_color = "white", breaks = my_breaks, cellwidth = 20, 
    cellheight = 20, treeheight_row = 20, treeheight_col = 20)
```

```{r Load_results}
results <- list()

        "_DE_Results_mPAP_mmHg.csv")))
    names(results)[i] <- cluster_names[i]
}
```

## Load signif

```{r Load_signif}
signif <- list()
for (i in seq_along(cluster_names)) {
    signif[[i]] <- read.csv(here::here("output", "Clinical_transcriptomic_associations", paste0(cluster_names[i], 
        "_DE_Significant_mPAP_mmHg.csv")))
    names(signif)[i] <- cluster_names[i]
}
```

## reference genes

```{r reference_genes}
reference_genes <- readGFF(here::here("data", "refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A", "genes", "genes.gtf"))
reference_genes <- unique(dplyr::select(reference_genes, gene_id, gene_type, gene_name))
```

## results add info gene type

```{r results_add_info_gene_type}
for (i in seq_along(results)) {
    results[[i]] <- left_join(results[[i]], reference_genes, by = c(gene = "gene_name"))
}
```

## results add info up down

```{r results_add_info_up_down}
for (i in seq_along(results)) {
    results[[i]]$up_down <- ifelse(results[[i]]$logFC > 0.5 & results[[i]]$FDR < 0.05, "Increased", ifelse(results[[i]]$logFC < 
        -0.5 & results[[i]]$FDR < 0.05, "Decreased", "Not significant"))
}
```

## results add info unique overlapping

```{r results_add_info_unique_overlapping}
for (i in seq_along(results)) {
    others_up <- unlist(lapply(signif[-i], function(df) df$gene[df$logFC > 0.5]))
    others_down <- unlist(lapply(signif[-i], function(df) df$gene[df$logFC < -0.5]))
    results[[i]]$unique_overlapping <- ifelse(results[[i]]$up_down == "Increased" & results[[i]]$gene %in% others_up, 
        "Overlapping", ifelse(results[[i]]$up_down == "Decreased" & results[[i]]$gene %in% others_down, "Overlapping", 
            ifelse(results[[i]]$up_down == "Increased" & !results[[i]]$gene %in% others_up, "Unique", ifelse(results[[i]]$up_down == 
                "Decreased" & !results[[i]]$gene %in% others_down, "Unique", "Not significant"))))
}
```

## get legend

```{r get_legend}
get_legend <- function(my_plot) {
    tmp <- ggplotGrob(my_plot)
    legend <- tmp$grobs[[which(sapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]]
    return(legend)
}
```

## Volcano up down

```{r Volcano_up_down, fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
volcano <- list()
for (i in seq_along(results)) {
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results[[i]]))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results[[i]]))
    keyvals[results[[i]]$up_down == "Increased"] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[results[[i]]$up_down == "Decreased"] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    volcano[[i]] <- EnhancedVolcano(results[[i]], lab = results[[i]]$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", ylab = bquote(-Log[10] ~ 
        FDR), labSize = 0, legendLabSize = 15, titleLabSize = 16, subtitleLabSize = 14, axisLabSize = 12, captionLabSize = 9, 
        pointSize = 1, FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3.5), colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, 
        subtitle = NULL, title = names(results)[i], colCustom = keyvals) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    names(volcano)[i] <- names(results)[i]
}
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(volcano[[1]] + theme(legend.position = "right"))
combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(volcano, ncol = 5)
final_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_plot(combined_plot, 0, 0, 1, 1) + cowplot::draw_plot(legend, 0.77, 
    0.15, 0.25, 0.25)
print(final_plot)
```

## Barplot up down

```{r Barplot_up_down, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=9}
n_de_genes <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_along(signif)) {
    cell_type <- c(rep(names(signif)[i], 2))
    effect <- c("Increased", "Decreased")
    n <- c(nrow(dplyr::filter(signif[[i]], logFC > 0)), nrow(dplyr::filter(signif[[i]], logFC < 0)))
    de_tot <- nrow(signif[[i]])
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, data.frame(cell_type, effect, n, de_tot))
}
n_de_genes <- n_de_genes %>% arrange(dplyr::desc(de_tot))
n_de_genes$cell_type <- factor(n_de_genes$cell_type, levels = unique(n_de_genes$cell_type))
ggplot(n_de_genes, aes(fill = effect, y = n, x = cell_type)) + geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Increased = "#A63A2A", Decreased = "#004C8C")) + theme(text = element_text(size = 15, 
    family = "Arial"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "Arial")) + labs(x = "Cell Type", 
    y = "Number of Genes", fill = "Effect") + guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```

## UpSet plot mPAP

```{r UpSet_plot_mPAP, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
gene_sets <- list()
for (i in seq_along(signif_up)) {
    gene_sets[[i]] <- signif_up[[i]]$gene
    names(gene_sets)[i] <- names(signif_up)[i]
}
m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets, mode = "distinct", min_set_size = 10)
m <- m[comb_size(m) >= 10]
p1 <- UpSet(m, column_title = "DE mPAP_mmHg - Upregulated", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, 
    add_numbers = TRUE), right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))
gene_sets <- list()
for (i in seq_along(signif_down)) {
    gene_sets[[i]] <- signif_down[[i]]$gene
    names(gene_sets)[i] <- names(signif_down)[i]
}
m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets, mode = "distinct", min_set_size = 10)
m <- m[comb_size(m) >= 10]
p2 <- UpSet(m, column_title = "DE mPAP_mmHg - Downregulated", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, 
    add_numbers = TRUE), right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE))
p1 <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(p1))
p2 <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(p2))
combined_plots <- plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1)
print(combined_plots)
rm(gene_sets, m, p1, p2, combined_plots)
```

## GSEA all

```{r GSEA_all, eval=TRUE}
rm(list = intersect(c("CM", "mat", "acts", "acts_pathway", "p", "p1", "p2", "p3", "plots", "df", "df_pathway", 
    "top_acts_mat"), ls()))
invisible(gc())
ranked_genes_nonCM <- list()
GSEA_all <- list()
for (i in seq_along(cluster_names_nonCM)) {
    gene_counts <- rowSums(subset(DCM_RV, cell_type == cluster_names_2[i])@assays$RNA@counts > 0)
    universe_genes <- names(gene_counts[gene_counts >= 3])
    write.csv(as.data.frame(universe_genes), here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(cluster_names_nonCM[i], "_universe_genes.csv")), 
        quote = F, row.names = F)
    universe_entrez <- bitr(universe_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)$ENTREZID
    write.csv(as.data.frame(universe_entrez), here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(cluster_names_nonCM[i], "_universe_entrez.csv")), 
        quote = F, row.names = F)
    rm(gene_counts)
    ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]] <- results[[cluster_names_nonCM[i]]]
    names(ranked_genes_nonCM)[i] <- cluster_names_nonCM[i]
    ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$metric <- ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$logFC * -log10(ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$PValue)
    entrezid <- bitr(ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
        drop = TRUE)
    ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]] <- merge(ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]], entrezid, by.x = "gene", by.y = "SYMBOL")
    ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]] <- ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]][!duplicated(ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$metric), ]
    write.csv(ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(cluster_names_nonCM[i], "_ranked_genes.csv")), 
        quote = F, row.names = F)
    genelist <- ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$metric
    names(genelist) <- ranked_genes_nonCM[[i]]$ENTREZID
    genelist <- genelist[order(genelist, decreasing = T)]
    GSEA_all[[i]] <- cached_gsea(geneList = genelist, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "ALL", keyType = "ENTREZID", 
        nPermSimple = 1e+06, minGSSize = 10, eps = 0)
    GSEA_all[[i]] <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(GSEA_all[[i]])
    names(GSEA_all)[i] <- cluster_names_nonCM[i]
    saveRDS(GSEA_all[i], here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(cluster_names_nonCM[i], "_GSEA_GO_mPAP.rds")))
}
rm(universe_genes, universe_entrez, genelist)
saveRDS(ranked_genes_nonCM, here::here(output_dir_data, "ranked_genes_nonCM_list.rds"))
saveRDS(GSEA_all, here::here(output_dir_data, "GSEA_all_nonCM_list.rds"))
```

## GSEA Endothelial cells

```{r GSEA_Endothelial_cells, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
stopifnot("Endothelial_cells" %in% names(GSEA_all), methods::is(GSEA_all[["Endothelial_cells"]], "gseaResult"))
if (nrow(GSEA_all[["Endothelial_cells"]]@result) == 0L) {
    cat("Endothelial cells: no GO terms returned at the original adjusted-P cutoff (0.05).\n")
} else {
    GSEA_simplified <- clusterProfiler::simplify(GSEA_all[["Endothelial_cells"]], cutoff = 0.75, by = "p.adjust", 
        select_fun = min, measure = "Wang", semData = NULL)
    GSEA_simplified <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(GSEA_simplified)
    dotplot(GSEA_simplified, showCategory = 8, split = ".sign", title = paste0("Endothelial cells", "\nGO Enrichment Analysis", 
        "\nmPAP-associated genes"), label_format = 40, font.size = 15) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
        size = 18, hjust = 0.5, family = "Arial"), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", family = "Arial"), 
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, family = "Arial")) + facet_grid(. ~ .sign)
}
```

## GSEA Endothelial cells emapplot

```{r GSEA_Endothelial_cells_emapplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
stopifnot("Endothelial_cells" %in% names(GSEA_all), methods::is(GSEA_all[["Endothelial_cells"]], "gseaResult"))
if (nrow(GSEA_all[["Endothelial_cells"]]@result) == 0L) {
    cat("Endothelial cells: no GO terms returned at the original adjusted-P cutoff (0.05).\n")
} else {
    GSEA_simplified@result <- classify_terms(GSEA_simplified@result)
    activated_terms <- subset(GSEA_simplified@result, sign == "activated")
    suppressed_terms <- subset(GSEA_simplified@result, sign == "suppressed")
    GSEA_activated <- GSEA_simplified
    GSEA_activated@result <- activated_terms
    GSEA_activated <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_activated)
    GSEA_suppressed <- GSEA_simplified
    GSEA_suppressed@result <- suppressed_terms
    GSEA_suppressed <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_suppressed)
    p1 <- emapplot(GSEA_activated, showCategory = 100, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.15) + ggtitle("Activated Terms") + 
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, family = "Arial"))
    p2 <- emapplot(GSEA_suppressed, showCategory = 100, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.15) + ggtitle("Suppressed Terms") + 
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, family = "Arial"))
    A_fix_network_coords <- function(p) {
        A_expand <- function(r) {
            d <- diff(r)
            if (d < 1e-08) 
                d <- max(abs(r), 1)
            r + c(-1, 1) * d * 0.15
        }
        p + coord_cartesian(xlim = A_expand(range(p$data$x)), ylim = A_expand(range(p$data$y)), clip = "off") + 
            theme(aspect.ratio = NULL)
    }
    p1 <- A_fix_network_coords(p1)
    p2 <- A_fix_network_coords(p2)
    combined_plot <- p1 | p2
    print(combined_plot)
    rm(GSEA_simplified, activated_terms, suppressed_terms, GSEA_activated, GSEA_suppressed, p1, p2)
}
```

```{r GSEA_Pericytes_emapplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
        A_expand <- function(r) {
            d <- diff(r)
            if (d < 1e-08) 
                d <- max(abs(r), 1)
            r + c(-1, 1) * d * 0.15
        }
        p + coord_cartesian(xlim = A_expand(range(p$data$x)), ylim = A_expand(range(p$data$y)), clip = "off") + 
            theme(aspect.ratio = NULL)
    }
    p1 <- A_fix_network_coords(p1)
    p2 <- A_fix_network_coords(p2)
    combined_plot <- p1 | p2
    print(combined_plot)
    rm(GSEA_simplified, activated_terms, suppressed_terms, GSEA_activated, GSEA_suppressed, p1, p2)
}
```

```{r GSEA_Macrophages, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
}
```

## Enrichment across cell types

```{r section_156, fig.height=11, fig.width=6, dpi = 300}
GSEA_all <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir_data, "GSEA_all_nonCM_list.rds"))
cell_order <- c("Fibroblasts", "Endothelial_cells", "Pericytes", "Macrophages", "Lymphocytes", "Smooth_muscle_cells", 
    "Neuronal_cells", "Endocardial_cells")
top_n_pos <- 4
top_n_neg <- 4
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
wrap_2lines <- function(x, width = 35) {
    vapply(x, function(s) {
        s <- as.character(s)
        if (nchar(s) <= width) 
            return(s)
        cut <- str_locate_all(substr(s, 1, width), " ")[[1]]
        cut <- if (nrow(cut) == 0) 
            width
        else max(cut[, 1])
        line1 <- str_trim(substr(s, 1, cut))
        rest <- str_trim(substr(s, cut + 1, nchar(s)))
        if (nchar(rest) > width) 
            rest <- paste0(substr(rest, 1, width - 1), "…")
        paste(line1, rest, sep = "\n")
    }, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
}
df_gsea <- lapply(cell_order, function(ct) {
    obj <- GSEA_all[[ct]]
    if (is.null(obj) || nrow(obj@result) == 0) 
        return(NULL)
    obj_simpl <- clusterProfiler::simplify(obj, cutoff = 0.6, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min, measure = "Wang", 
        semData = NULL)
    res <- obj_simpl@result %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(cell_type = ct) %>% filter(!is.na(NES), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>% 
        filter(p.adjust < padj_cutoff)
    if (nrow(res) == 0) 
        return(NULL)
    pos <- res %>% filter(NES > 0) %>% arrange(dplyr::desc(NES)) %>% slice_head(n = top_n_pos)
    neg <- res %>% filter(NES < 0) %>% arrange(NES) %>% slice_head(n = top_n_neg)
    bind_rows(pos, neg)
}) %>% bind_rows()
if (nrow(df_gsea) == 0) {
    message("No significant terms (p.adjust < ", padj_cutoff, ") found.")
} else {
    df_gsea <- df_gsea %>% mutate(p_for_color = if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(.)) 
        pvalue
    else p.adjust, score = -log10(p_for_color) * sign(NES), cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_order), 
        desc_id = paste(cell_type, Description, sep = "___"))
    desc_levels <- df_gsea %>% arrange(cell_type, NES) %>% pull(desc_id)
    df_gsea$desc_id <- factor(df_gsea$desc_id, levels = unique(desc_levels))
    L <- unname(quantile(abs(df_gsea$score), probs = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (!is.finite(L) || L == 0) 
        L <- max(abs(df_gsea$score), na.rm = TRUE)
    ggplot(df_gsea, aes(x = desc_id, y = NES, fill = score)) + geom_col(width = 0.9) + facet_grid(cell_type ~ ., 
        scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y", labeller = labeller(cell_type = function(x) gsub("_", 
            " ", x))) + scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#004C8C", mid = "white", high = "#A63A2A", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-L, 
        L), oob = scales::squish, name = expression(-log[10](p) %*% sign(NES))) + scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
        term <- sub("^.*___", "", x)
        wrap_2lines(term, width = 37)
    }) + coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)") + theme_bw(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") + 
        theme(text = element_text(color = "black", family = "Arial"), axis.text = element_text(color = "black", 
            family = "Arial"), axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, family = "Arial"), plot.title = element_blank(), 
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.2, family = "Arial"), strip.background = element_blank(), strip.placement = "outside", 
            strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black", family = "Arial"), 
            panel.spacing.y = unit(0.6, "lines"), legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal", 
            legend.title = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"), legend.text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial")) + 
        guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(6, "cm"), barheight = unit(0.3, "cm"), title.position = "top", 
            title.hjust = 0.5))
}
```
